Market today: Stocks are falling as the 10-year Treasury yield heads towards 5%, which is putting pressure on growth names. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, is feeling this pinch.

Your holdings: SMCI (-36.67%) and SOXL (-75.06%) are the biggest pain points, both marked SELL. PLTU (-24.2%) and MU (-59.4%) are also deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. If it keeps climbing, it'll be tough for your tech holdings.

Bottom line: You're heavily exposed to rising rates, and your leveraged ETFs are bleeding.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's a SELL with a big loss. Consider cutting losses if it breaks below its stop.
Trim SOXL: Another deep loss SELL. Re-evaluate if you can stomach further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
